source.method: Fresh unauthenticated Playwright context; public IAM form before and after a trusted Sign in click with empty Account ID and fictitious username/password. Client validation shows Account is required. No authentication performed.

redactions: All editable values, URL values, scripts and event handlers omitted by the public-form collector.
Only the public form and eight real ancestor shells retained; five unrelated branches omitted.
replay: tests/browser/aws-inline-regression.mjs morphs recorded attributes, text and appended error nodes while preserving the original form and input elements. The computed CSS is replaced with the observed error-state CSS. Fictitious field values are seeded locally. No AWS JavaScript executes; no network authentication occurs.
limitations: Computed CSS is a reduced layout specimen, not the entire page.
The replay implements only the observed Account-required transition, not general AWS validation.
Explicit credential choice is tested against the synthetic Palladin provider. Real-account login remains a manual acceptance step.

liveAcceptance.scope: Public AWS IAM required-account validation, fictitious username/password, no authentication

regression.prefilledChoiceRed: Previous username remained instead of the selected account; no-form outcome.
regression.layoutRed: Retained username moved but launcher stayed 10 pixels above its center in Chromium.
regression.agent: Existing initial AWS fixture covers Agent inspection/fill. This added transition covers the user launcher; it does not enable overwrite for Agent delivery.
